name: Saratoga County, NY
findings: Saratoga County has 712 nonprofit organizations. 340 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 291 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Saratoga County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 13 housing organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
